_note: Reference scale (96 m arena, terraces 0-12 m). Multiply every distance and height by arena_scale. ground_y = world height of the strip's ground line; fog_floor/fog_band drive the shader's fog bank. Ring height = circumference * strip_h / (2 * strip_w); ring bottom = ground_y - ground_px_from_bottom * ring_h / strip_h (ground_px in strips/strips.json).
